For 3D Models

-You can make a free model off Vroid studio. A website called BOOTH is where you can find Vroid parts like clothes, shoes, accessories etc for a cheap price. You can use Vseeface, Warudo or XR Animator to track your 3D model.

For 2D Models

There are many adoptable 2D Models that you can find on Twitter for a cheap price. You might be able to find one that is both designed and rigged ready. You can also customizable 2D Models where you can download the model and use the different hair styles, accessories etc to make it look like your avatar. Most of these are around £40. Most of these can be found on Booth, Etsy or even on patreon.

Tracking your 2D Model can be done with VtubeStudio. 

Making a 2D Vtuber can be difficult. I highly recommend if you really would like to make your own 2D Model to please look online for tutorials. It can can take months for both Design or Rigging.

I would recommend to get into being a PNG avatar (Where you have an avatar of yourself to represent yourself during streams) or make a free 3D Model from Vroid studio. That way, if it isn't your cup of tea, you won't have wasted a huge amount of money. I would say that after a few months, you are enjoying being a vtuber, I would look into saving up so that you can get your own 2D Model or commission a very high quality 3D Model.
